name: Aachen
type: college town; big city; border city; special municipality association of Germany; spa town; urban municipality in Germany; urban district of North Rhine-Westphalia
text: Aachen is the 13th-largest city in North Rhine-Westphalia and the 27th-largest city of Germany, with around 264,000 inhabitants. It is the western-most major city in Germany, lying approximately 61 km (38 mi) west of Cologne and Bonn, directly bordering Belgium in the southwest, and the Netherlands in the northwest. The city lies in the Meuse–Rhine Euroregion and is the seat of the district of Aachen (Städteregion Aachen).

depictions.name: Aachen
depictions.text: real was the first major town captured by the Americans in Nazi Germany during World War II in the Battle of Aachen. It is featured in Call of Duty: Finest Hour and Call of Duty: WWII.
